description: This file defines the LogWrapper class which wraps Android's native Log utility, providing an interface for logging with optional chaining to other LogNodes in a logging chain.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A class that implements LogNode interface to wrap Android's native Log and supports chaining to subsequent LogNode objects.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data after this one.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs the message with specified priority, tag, and optional throwable; forwards the log to the next node if present.
